lines.text: a hint of love, a clue
we are still and no one's breathing
time has left and there's no reaching
there is not a word to journal
love is here and knows no boundaries
we've arrived we never left the

n1.body:
this is the one song on the album co-written by mary ocher. she had invited me to try and write something a long while ago and we didn't end up with anything substantial. i had a few lines jotted down and cannot remember which of the ones in the actual song were hers, but what most stuck with me was her striking single string melody and vocal line here used in the verses:

faith.
